name: What is the process for scheduling accessibility maintenance with City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for scheduling accessibility maintenance with City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Scheduling accessibility maintenance with City Dweller, LLC is straightforward. You can contact us by phone or through our website to describe the features needing attention. We will then arrange a convenient time for a site visit to assess the condition of your accessibility modifications. Following the assessment, we provide a detailed proposal outlining the recommended maintenance, necessary repairs, costs, and timeline. Once approved, our team will schedule and complete the work efficiently and professionally, ensuring minimal disruption.
